scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@infralynx/shared && npm run build --workspace=@infralynx/api && npm run build --workspace=@infralynx/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@infralynx/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@infralynx/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@infralynx/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@infralynx/web"
scripts.test: npm run prepare:shared && npm run test --workspace=@infralynx/shared && npm run test --workspace=@infralynx/api && npm run test --workspace=@infralynx/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
